# durantic_route_policy_set (Data Source)

Looks up a Durantic route policy set by UUID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Look up a route policy set by name.
data "durantic_route_policy_set" "upstream_in" {
  name = "upstream-in"
}

# Route policy sets can also be looked up by UUID.
data "durantic_route_policy_set" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
}

# Use an existing policy set as the import policy of an external BGP peer.
resource "durantic_external_bgp_peer" "upstream" {
  machine_uuid       = data.durantic_machine.gateway.uuid
  name               = "upstream-transit"
  peer_ip            = "192.0.2.1"
  peer_asn           = 64512
  import_policy_uuid = data.durantic_route_policy_set.upstream_in.uuid
}

data "durantic_machine" "gateway" {
  hostname = "gateway-01"
}

output "upstream_in_rule_count" {
  value = length(data.durantic_route_policy_set.upstream_in.rules)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the route policy set. Set either `uuid` or `name`.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the route policy set. Set either `uuid` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `advanced_mode` (Boolean) Whether the policy set uses advanced mode (explicit rules).
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the route policy set was created.
- `default_action` (String) Action taken when no rule matches.
- `description` (String) Description of the route policy set.
- `local_pref` (Number) Local preference applied to routes accepted by the policy set, if any.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Policy rules in evaluation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the route policy set was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action taken when the rule matches (`accept` or `reject`).
- `add_communities` (List of String) Communities to add to matching routes.
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is active.
- `match_as_path_regex` (String) AS path regular expression the rule matches.
- `match_communities` (List of String) BGP communities the rule matches.
- `match_prefix_len_max` (Number) Maximum prefix length to match.
- `match_prefix_len_min` (Number) Minimum prefix length to match.
- `match_prefixes` (List of String) Prefixes the rule matches.
- `match_type` (String) What the rule matches on.
- `prepend_as_count` (Number) Number of times to prepend the local AS to matching routes.
- `remove_communities` (List of String) Communities to remove from matching routes.
- `sequence` (Number) Rule evaluation order. Lower numbers are evaluated first.
- `set_communities` (List of String) Communities to set on matching routes, replacing existing ones.
- `set_local_pref` (Number) Local preference to set on matching routes.
- `set_med` (Number) MED to set on matching routes.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the rule.
